targets.note: The Rivera matter folder: back and forward arrows, the path, Sort and the list/grid switch, Upload, the filled New button, the more menu and the side-pane toggle; Kind as plain text and Made by as a face on every line, beside the shared place sidebar. The prototype side is its Files place on the same folder in the same skin.
Rivera matter with the staged-writes banner: Docs staged 3 writes here, Nothing is saved until you approve, Review and Approve. The prototype opens this same folder with its change set open.

The sidebar in the shared place sidebar: title and search, Recent, Starred with its count, Shared with me, Knowledge (Memory, Graph), then Space with All files, the Agents folders with each agent's face, the Projects folders and the Space's other folders. The prototype side is its Files place in the same skin, on the same folder.
Starred opened: the starred files, with the star after the name. The prototype side is its Files place after pressing Starred.

A file with two edits carries the Conflict tag after its name (click to resolve). The prototype side is its Rivera matter folder, where site-photo.png has the tag (new hash token rivera in the prototype copy, ruling 42).
